note: Each wallet material as a vanilla item: tagged with custom_data {ascensionlib:{material, batch?}} and a custom_model_data the server resource pack maps to art. Base items are inert and stack to 64. A tradable value of false keeps a material out of withdrawal (default true). An item with no batch is LOOT FORM (absorbed into the wallet when carried); an item with a batch is a VOUCHER (tradable, redeemed with /ascend wallet deposit).

facet.name: Facet
lore: A cut crystal that sharpens an affix.

unique_catalyst.name: Unique Catalyst

ascension_sigil.name: Ascension Sigil
lore: Gives a Pokemon with no profile

tower_mark.name: Tower Mark
lore: Bound to you; it cannot be traded.
